mcqs.question: Which drug was approved by the US FDA as the first oral PCSK9 inhibitor for lowering LDL cholesterol?
mcqs.explanation: Lipefendra was approved by the US FDA as the first oral PCSK9 inhibitor for LDL cholesterol, and it was developed by Merck. Qdenga, Vepdegestrant and SHETA2 refer to different medical developments.
